caseNameFull: Finch, Secretary of Health, Education, and Welfare v. Perales

opinions.text: C. A. 5th Cir. [Certiorari granted, 397 U. S. 1035.] Motion of respondent for the appointment of counsel granted. It is ordered that Richard Tinsman, Esquire, of San Antonio, Texas, a member of the Bar of this Court, be, and he is hereby, appointed to serve as counsel for respondent in this case.
